نتعاون (form VI)
# نَتَعَاوَنُ (nataʕāwanu) /na.ta.ʕaː.wa.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاوَنَ (taʕāwana)
# نَتَعَاوَنَ (nataʕāwana) /na.ta.ʕaː.wa.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاوَنَ (taʕāwana)
# نَتَعَاوَنْ (nataʕāwan) /na.ta.ʕaː.wan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاوَنَ (taʕāwana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
